novelty_flags.label: Definitions def:ppml-influence and def:efficient-estimator; Theorems 4–8
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposal calls its cohort-mean score estimator the Moreau--Kastler PPML-imputation estimator, but the cited paper estimates individual fixed effects on untreated individual observations and predicts individual counterfactuals; no equivalence to the proposed cohort-mean estimator is stated or derived.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 2–3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The tangent equality and efficiency bound are conditional on the explicitly mean-differentiable DQM experiment, excluding tail-escaping score paths whose moment derivatives fail.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The semiparametric efficiency and attainment claims are relative to that stated pointwise finite-fourth-moment experiment, not to every conceivable DQM path with the same observed law.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Either rename the comparator as a new cohort-mean PPML-imputation estimator informed by Moreau--Kastler, or add an explicit theorem giving exact conditions under which it equals Moreau--Kastler's individual-fixed-effect imputation ratio.

Add Wooldridge's staggered nonlinear-DiD/fully-interacted imputation work to related work and explicitly distinguish its individual-level counterfactual specification from the cohort-mean rank-one model.

Promote the observable rank-q covariance map and the acyclic universal-efficiency iff as the headline, with the individual-comparator relation stated as a separate boundary corollary rather than as an asserted identity.

recommended_next_step: Revise the Moreau--Kastler comparator characterization and either prove a comparator-equivalence bridge or recast the estimator as a distinct cohort-mean construction; then retain the field-tier cycle-frontier kernel.
